title: An interview with Mark Zuckerberg, who says Meta has caught up with rivals at the frontier of AI with its Wonder model and rejects calls for a slowdown (Hannah Murphy/Financial Times)
commentary: Zuckerberg declaring Meta has 'caught up' is either true or the most expensive PR campaign in history — fourteen months of ground-up rebuild, and the benchmarks say it's competitive with Anthropic's Sonnet. The rejecting-a-slowdown part is the real signal: full speed ahead, safety concerns be damned.
